entities.summary: Abbey Chile Abuede professionally known as Sexy Steel, is a Nigerian designer, stylist, actor, musician, and entrepreneur. In 2012, his song Bebedi Alhaja won the awards for Best Video of the Year, Best Video Director and Best Indigenous Concept at the Nigerian Music Video Awards (NMVA).
